artworks.title: Satan Before the Throne of God
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial figure on a throne surrounded by angels and people. The central figure is seated on a raised platform, enveloped in flowing robes with an aura around the head. Other figures are positioned around in various poses. The background shows billowing clouds and the border has intricate designs with flames and scrolls. Text above and below the image provides context, likely from a religious or philosophical text.

artworks.title: The Destruction of Job's Sons
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a winged figure descending from a turbulent sky. Below them, multiple human forms are entangled amidst destroyed architecture. The figures express emotions such as fear and despair. The style is intricate with detailed line work, suggesting a narrative with mythological or biblical undertones. The border features text that reinforces the theme of divine or cosmic calamity, adding context to the scene with quotes and inscriptions.

artworks.title: The Messengers Tell Job of His Misfortunes
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central male figure in a dynamic pose, gesturing towards a seated figure under a tree. The seated figure raises their hands and gazes outward with a thoughtful expression. The background shows detailed landscapes, possibly mountains. Text from a biblical narrative is inscribed around the central image. The artistic style resembles that of William Blake.

artworks.title: Satan Going Forth from the Presence of the Lord
artworks.description: This image features ethereal figures and symbolic representations. In the center, a robed figure with a halo sits on a pedestal, surrounded by adoring figures. Below, a scene shows a robed figure conversing with an elderly figure, with an animal nearby. Angelic beings stand on either side. Intricate designs frame the composition, including snake-like motifs. Textual elements provide context to the scenes depicted.

artworks.title: Satan Smiting Job with Boils
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing in the center with outstretched arms, holding lightning bolts in one hand. To the left, a person sits on the ground with their face covered by hands, while another figure lies on the ground. In the background, there are dramatic clouds, a setting sun, and a distant landscape with a structure. The scene is framed by decorative elements and inscriptions alluding to the biblical story of Job. Below the central image are additional decorations.

artworks.title: Job's Comforters
artworks.description: The image shows a central male figure who is seated with his legs bent and arms covering his chest. Surrounding him are figures standing with their arms raised. The seated man has a long beard and thinning hair. The figures have sorrowful expressions and wear long robes. The scene includes a structure behind the central figure, with a landscape in the distance. The image is framed with decorative borders and text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Job's Despair
artworks.description: The image shows three figures sitting on the ground. The central figure is seated with legs bent and arms raised above his head. The central figure is unclothed, while the two figures on either side are dressed in flowing garments with their heads down. The setting includes swirling clouds and a large rectangular structure in the rear, with a desolate landscape of barren rock formations or mountains. The illustration is framed by floral and wavy decorative patterns, with calligraphic text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: The Vision of Eliphaz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures looking at a central ethereal being. The central image is surrounded by a text that reads "Then a spirit passed before my face, the hair of my flesh stood up.” The figures are depicted in robes and intricate linework. The central being is surrounded by a radiant light and is gazing at the figures below. The figures show various emotional states, some looking up in awe or contemplation. The scene is framed by text in a stylized border with phrases suggesting a spiritual or religious context. The artwork evokes themes of divine revelation and spiritual enlightenment with attention to detail and narrative depth. The composition and execution suggest a visionary or mystical experience and are consistent with themes found in works of mythological or spiritual literature.

artworks.title: Job Rebuked by His Friends
artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving depicting a scene with a bearded man sitting surrounded by other figures in biblical clothing. The background shows mountains and a textured sky. Decorative elements like birds are at the bottom corners, and there is text above and below the central image.

artworks.title: Job's Evil Dreams
artworks.description: The image depicts a surreal scene featuring mythical creatures. A central figure resembling a hybrid creature, possibly a mixture of a serpent, lion, and human, is surrounded by smaller hybrid figures. The drawing is detailed with various textures and intricate line work, creating a dream-like quality. Inscriptions with themes of wickedness, hypocrisy, dreams, visions, and references to Satan and God are included in a border around the central image. The overall style is reminiscent of William Blake's works, combining poetry with visionary art.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Elihu
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures seated under a starry sky. The central illustration features several figures in expressive poses, surrounded by a sky filled with stars. One figure stands and gestures with one arm raised, while others sit on the ground, wrapped in robes and displaying various emotional expressions. The scene is framed with line work that includes text excerpts, forming decorative borders. The arrangement of text and imagery implies narrative or symbolic elements with phrases related to existential and spiritual themes. The style shows influences typical of visionary art.

artworks.title: The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a biblical scene with a divine figure and onlookers. The scene is intricately sketched with fine lines primarily in monochrome tones, capturing a dynamic, swirling environment. At the center is a powerful figure emerging from a whirlwind. The figure displays an expression of authority and wisdom, surrounded by swirling lines suggesting movement and spiritual energy. Below, two observers appear to be listening intently. Surrounding text refers to divine communication and weather phenomena. The lower text hints at the narrative context, involving a deity's response. The swirling atmospheric elements around the figure emphasize themes of divine authority, human humility, and the interaction of natural elements with spiritual imagery.

artworks.title: The Creation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of angels and celestial beings. The image depicts a central scene with several celestial beings with wings arranged in ethereal poses, surrounded by flowing drapery and clouds. Below them, a wise figure reclines on clouds with outstretched arms, beneath whom a group of seated figures appears in contemplation or discussion, dressed in flowing robes. The border of the drawing contains celestial and earthly symbolism, with motifs like stars, the sun, moon, and natural elements. The incorporated text adds a layer of poetic and spiritual context to the scene depicted. The intricate details and symbolic language convey a profound sense of the cosmos and divine creation.

artworks.title: Behemoth and Leviathan
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting five human figures, a Behemoth, and a Leviathan. The central panel shows two angelic figures beside a central human-like figure, surrounded by smaller human forms. Below them, a Behemoth stands next to a coiled Leviathan. The composition is bordered with text related to the biblical Behemoth and Leviathan, and the style resembles that of William Blake, including swirling clouds and celestial imagery.

artworks.title: The Fall of Satan
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a celestial judgment scene with divine and infernal figures. The central figure is seated on a throne, surrounded by auras and smaller celestial beings. On either side, two large winged figures are present. Below, a group of figures appear in anguished poses amidst flames. The image is encased in a border with text. The composition features intricate linework and captures an intense atmosphere. Text included around the drawing provides commentary related to judgment, wisdom, and divine authority.

artworks.title: The Vision of God
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene where a majestic figure blesses two kneeling followers in the center. The figures are surrounded by intricate inscriptions and an angelic figure with scrolls below them.

artworks.title: Job's Sacrifice
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a biblical scene with an altar and individuals in prayer. The central image shows a figure in front of an altar, arms stretched out, surrounded by figures sitting or kneeling with heads bowed. The background shows beams of light from the sky, framed by swirling clouds. Angelic figures and scripture scrolls are added within the border surrounding the central scene. Inscriptions include phrases like "Also the Lord accepted Job" and "And my Servant Job shall pray for you."

artworks.title: Job Accepting Charity
artworks.description: This is a drawing with text and illustrative figures. The image shows a group of figures under a tree, with some observing two seated figures on the opposite side. Ornamental designs embellish the upper and lower portions of the image. In the upper section, there is a text that reads "The Lord maketh Poor & maketh Rich" and "He bringeth Low & Lifteth Up." The central image shows a scene under a large tree with a textured background. The image is framed by decorative elements that blend foliage and biblical text. At the bottom, more text reads "Every one also gave him a piece of Money." The signature "W. Blake inv & sculp" indicates the artist's style is in the manner of William Blake.

artworks.title: Job and His Daughters
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The central figure is surrounded by symbolic imagery. The central figure sits with three figures at his feet. The background contains circular motifs illustrating abstract scenes. The image is framed by decorative foliage and biblical text. There is a theme of music suggested by a stringed instrument in the drawing.

artworks.title: Job and His Wife Restored to Prosperity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene featuring multiple figures and symbolic elements. The central image shows figures in robes, some with musical instruments, surrounded by sheep. The background includes a detailed landscape with a crescent moon and a bright light. Within a decorative border, there are inscriptions with biblical allusions, including references to the life of Job from the Old Testament. The drawing includes elaborate details in the figures' garments and has a sense of harmonious gathering. The text below the central scene references the blessing of Job's latter life with mentions of longevity and generational prosperity.

artworks.title: May-Day in London
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a scene on May Day in London. The image shows a busy street filled with activities. 

Full-description: The drawing depicts characters engaging in a festive atmosphere, including musicians and dancers. In the center, people in period costumes are dancing, some holding hands and others clapping. The background shows urban buildings with banners and signs announcing events like concerts. A man is seen carrying a pole decorated with cups and teapots, possibly for street performance or sales. Dogs are also present. The characters' expressions and body language suggest joy and excitement. Onlookers lean out from upper floor windows to watch the festivities.

artworks.title: The Discomfited Duellists
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic and humorous scene in an interior room. Several figures dressed in 18th-century clothing are engaged in a comical brawl. Two men are confronting each other, with one being pushed against a fireplace. Other figures are involved in different ways, some trying to separate individuals while others are watching. The room includes a fireplace, chairs, artwork on the wall, and a cabinet with decorative items. Two individuals near the wall are holding jugs or bottles, observing the scene. The drawing conveys disorder and absurdity with exaggerated facial expressions and postures.

artworks.title: Fertilization of Egypt
artworks.description: This print depicts a large person standing over a landscape with flowing water. The person is seen from the back, and they are standing with their legs wide, their feet on either side of a river. Their arms are raised to the sky, their hands clasped with the palms together. The person is nude except for a cloth wrapped around their waist. They appear to have the head of an animal, similar to a dog with large ears. Their snout is lifted to the sky, which is filled with clouds. There is a bright six-pointed star directly above the person's raised hands. Below the person, a large waterfall leads into the river at the bottom. At the top of the waterfall is the vague shape of a bearded man's head, with his arms stretched out to either side. The water seems to flow from his beard and arms. On the right side of the river, there are two pyramids, and on the left is an object that looks like the end of an oar or paddle with horizontal bars across it. Beyond the man in the waterfall, the landscape continues into rolling hills with some rivers or roads winding through them.

artworks.title: A Coromantyn Free Negro, or Ranger, armed
artworks.artist: William Blake after John Gabriel Stedman
artworks.description: There is a full-body illustration of a person standing upright, facing forward with a rifle resting across their shoulders and held by both hands. The person's facial features are captured in detail, with a neutral expression, and they have short, curly hair adorned with a decorative piece. They are minimally clothed, wearing a form of cloth around their waist and an ornamental strap across their chest. The person holds a rifle and has a sheath with a knife or blade attached to their side. The background depicts an open landscape with a few palm trees and two figures in the distance, also holding rifles and appearing to be in motion. The ground is depicted with some foliage and textured to indicate grass or dirt.
